synopsis: CM Labs Vortex Studio is commercial real-time multibody physics software for heavy equipment, including off-road vehicles, earthmoving, cranes and cables, and is identified among the tools with clear heavy-machinery relevance [f8576, f8672, f8663]. Its documented applications are mainly operator training, including OETIO and CONEXPO showcases; autonomy use remains a vendor claim, with no autonomy-validation customers found [f8579, f8674, f8580, f9116, f16048]. CM Labs markets engineering-grade tracked-vehicle and “sensor-grade” simulation, but the booklet's expert assessment characterizes this class of heavy-machine physics tools as strong in terrain and hydraulics yet thin in sensor and scenario tooling [f8577, f9117, f8283]. Vortex supports HIL with real controls and PLCs, and appears as a heavy-machine dynamics option in the highest-cost example chain alongside specialist sensor simulation, test benches and cloud execution [f8578, f8365, f16167, f9304]. The latest documentation or release entry found was version 2024.3, and public pricing was not published, leaving currency and procurement-cost gaps [f8581, f9120, f9119].
